purpose: Fresh terse player-language Gate 3 tranche L benchmark authored only after r22 production deployment and current-live-publication verification succeeded; it was not used to construct r22.
blindnessPolicy: This tranche was authored after production verification of r22 and was not used to construct r22.
Do not edit or retroactively regrade this tranche after its first paid live run.
Do not exactly reuse prior Gate 2 or Gate 3 A/B/C/D/E/F/G/H/I/J/K player-language questions.
Semantic criteria are limited to the answer actually requested.

cases.question: 2 advantage + 1 disadvantage = just 1 advantage?
expectedSourceGroups: double advantage plus one disadvantage leaves one net advantage

cases.question: asset cap drops and i have to pitch one. counts as Removed?

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. A forced discard caused by the Asset limit dropping counts as Removed.

cases.question: asset expires by its own text. Removed trigger?
expectedSourceGroups: normal resolution, expiration, or self-removal condition does not count as Removal

semanticCriteria.statement: No. Normal self-expiration is not Removal unless expressly stated.

cases.question: counterintel blocks the whole reveal effect, not just seeing the cards?
expectedSourceGroups: prevents the entire opposing revealing effect

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. Counterintelligence prevents the entire opposing revealing effect.

cases.question: compound interest peek: treasury or discard, my choice?
expectedSourceGroups: Place it face up in your Treasury or put it in your Discard Pile

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. You choose Treasury or Discard Pile.

cases.question: contingency plan gets forced out by lower asset cap. +1 card?
expectedSourceGroups: If this card is Removed, +1 Card

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. The forced discard is Removal, so Contingency Plan gives +1 Card.

cases.question: poison gas: set gambit, so no tactics for me?
expectedSourceGroups: may employ Gambits or Tactics, but not both

semanticCriteria.statement: Correct. If you use a Gambit there, you cannot also use Tactics.

cases.question: monastery active. invocation can't move my grave card out?
expectedSourceGroups: cards cannot leave either player's Graveyard
move one card from your Graveyard to your Discard Pile

semanticCriteria.statement: Correct. Monastery prevents Invocation from moving the card out of the Graveyard.

cases.question: command tent gives opening + denouement actions, but first in each has to be a card action?
expectedSourceGroups: take Actions during both Opening and Denouement
first Action in each phase must be used to play a card for its Action effect

cases.question: field hospital can send my gambit to discard instead of grave?
expectedSourceGroups: put 1 of their cards from that battle in their Discard Pile instead of their Graveyard

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes, if you control Field Hospital and the battle was there.

cases.question: regime change means their leader abilities are off?
expectedSourceGroups: The opponent cannot use their Leader abilities

cases.question: malleus calls it heretical. stays Arcane through end of turn?
expectedSourceGroups: Arcane trait for that play or reveal and until the end of the turn

cases.question: rite binding ends with no special destination. bound cards go grave?
expectedSourceGroups: put its bound cards in their owners' Graveyards

cases.question: reroll is worse. stuck with new die?
expectedSourceGroups: reroll replaces the result it rerolls

semanticCriteria.statement: Yes. The new result replaces the old one unless the effect says otherwise.
